# apple_submit_for_review (Action)

Submits an App Store version to App Review. The version needs a build and the metadata App Review requires. The version is added to the platform's review submission that is being prepared, or a new one, which is then submitted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_submit_for_review" "ios" {
  config {
    version_id = apple_app_store_version.ios.id
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `version_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Store version, e.g. `apple_app_store_version.example.id`.
